visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young woman with long black hair, wearing a low-cut black lace top and a black outer robe, stands at the entrance of a Japanese-style restaurant. She smiles broadly and gestures toward the interior while colorful flower stands are visible on both sides of the wooden doorway. (2) Inside the dimly lit restaurant, she points toward a large chalkboard filled with handwritten Japanese and Chinese characters. She wears a cheerful expression and moves her hands energetically to emphasize the text written on the board. (3) The camera captures close-up shots of a chef tossing noodles in a large metal wok over a high gas flame, followed by a still shot of a detailed paper menu listing various Japanese dishes and their prices. (4) Sitting at a wooden table, the woman holds up a small glass of dark purple liquid and takes a sip, appearing to enjoy the taste. Several dishes including a pan of baked cheese and grilled items are spread out in front of her. (5) She uses chopsticks to lift a large portion of melted cheese from a baked potato dish and then shows a piece of grilled yam to the camera. The background shows Japanese decorative fans and other patrons eating at nearby tables. (6) In a rapid montage, she is seen eating stir-fried green vegetables, clinking glasses for a toast, and sampling grilled squid and skewers. She displays a QR code sign for a social media promotion while continuing to eat and talk. (7) Finally, she stands before the camera, putting her hands together in a thankful gesture, with her location and shop details displayed as text at the bottom of the screen.

narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video serves as a promotional review for 'Old Chuan Jiao' (老串角) izakaya in Taipei's Da'an District. It utilizes an attractive female influencer to showcase the restaurant's vibrant atmosphere, extensive menu of grilled dishes and drinks, and specific promotional offers like 'buy three get one free' beer to entice viewers to visit.
